cards.name: Caterpie
cards.description: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.

cards.name: Zygarde
cards.description: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.

cards.name: Meowth
cards.description: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.

cards.name: Persian
cards.description: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.

cards.name: Porygon
cards.description: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: For the purposes of planetary development, Porygon was updated with the most cutting-edge technology available.

cards.name: Porygon-Z
cards.description: In order to create a more advanced Pokémon, an additional program was installed, but apparently it contained a defect that makes it move oddly.

cards.name: Hoothoot
cards.description: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: They charge wildly and headbutt everything. Their headbutts have enough destructive force to derail a train.

cards.name: Noibat
cards.description: They live in pitch black caves. Their enormous ears can emit ultrasonic waves of 200,000 hertz.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies' bellies, then lifts and throws them.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: Despite its adorable appearance, when it gets angry and flails about, its arms and legs could knock a pro wrestler sprawling.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: This immensely dangerous Pokémon possesses overwhelming physical strength. Its habitat is generally off-limits.

cards.name: Pansage
cards.description: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

cards.name: Simisage
cards.description: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: It crawls onto the land in search of food. Its water bubble allows it to breathe and protects its soft head.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It delivers headbutts with the water bubble on its head. Small Pokémon get sucked into the bubble, where they drown.

cards.name: Wimpod
cards.description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.

cards.name: Charmeleon
cards.description: It lashes about with its tail to knock down its foe. It then tears up the fallen opponent with sharp claws.

cards.name: Metapod
cards.description: Its shell is filled with its soft innards. It doesn't move much because of the risk it might carelessly spill its innards out.

cards.name: Pansear
cards.description: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.

cards.name: Simisear
cards.description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

cards.name: Heatmor
cards.description: Using their very hot, flame-covered tongues, they burn through Durant's steel bodies and consume their insides.

cards.name: Turtonator
cards.description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.description: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.

cards.name: Butterfree
cards.description: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.

cards.name: Seadra
cards.description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.

cards.name: Kingdra
cards.description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

cards.name: Magikarp
cards.description: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.

cards.name: Gyarados
cards.description: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.

cards.name: Marill
cards.description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.

cards.name: Azumarill
cards.description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.

cards.name: Panpour
cards.description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.

cards.name: Simipour
cards.description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

cards.name: Bruxish
cards.description: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.

cards.name: Electabuzz
cards.description: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.

cards.name: Electivire
cards.description: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.

cards.name: Tynamo
cards.description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.

cards.name: Eelektrik
cards.description: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.

cards.name: Eelektross
cards.description: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.

cards.name: Slowking
cards.description: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.

cards.name: Wobbuffet
cards.description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Seviper
cards.description: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Croagunk
cards.description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

cards.name: Toxicroak
cards.description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.

cards.name: Venipede
cards.description: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.

cards.name: Whirlipede
cards.description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.

cards.name: Scolipede
cards.description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.

cards.name: Espurr
cards.description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.

cards.name: Vileplume
cards.description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.

cards.name: Meowstic
cards.description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.

cards.name: Rhyhorn
cards.description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.

cards.name: Rhydon
cards.description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Rhyperior
cards.description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.

cards.name: Lunatone
cards.description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.

cards.name: Solrock
cards.description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Riolu
cards.description: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.

cards.name: Lucario
cards.description: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.

cards.name: Sawk
cards.description: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.

cards.name: Mudbray
cards.description: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.

cards.name: Mudsdale
cards.description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Alolan Rattata
cards.description: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

cards.name: Alolan Raticate
cards.description: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.description: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.

cards.name: Darkrai
cards.description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.

cards.name: Inkay
cards.description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.

cards.name: Ledyba
cards.description: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.

cards.name: Malamar
cards.description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Diancie
cards.description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.

cards.name: Cutiefly
cards.description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.

cards.name: Ribombee
cards.description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.

cards.name: Morelull
cards.description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.

cards.name: Shiinotic
cards.description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
